about_the_game:
The key features of this DLC update are as follows:

1, Introduction of 24 new generals, each with unique icons.
2, Each general comes with exclusive skills and sets, with special bonuses and effects upon set activation.
3, Players can now choose to join a faction from the beginning without the need for self-construction.
4, With the expansion pack, in-game features such as the interracial invasion, mythical beast trial, and cottage banditry system, horse Race and hana card will no longer produce duplicate sets (sets are now unique).

How to use:
After installation, navigate to the faction selection screen when creating a new script, check the "Heroes Assemble" expansion pack within the "DLC" section.
Choose to recruit new generals, and they will be available for selection in the list of available generals.
